approach: Human-Model Agreement Study following Plank et al. (2014). Annotator A = IndoNLU EmoT crowd labels (GROUND_TRUTH). Annotator B = MBG-trained model predictions.
interpretation_logReg: Domain Shift Undefined (NaN — single shared label)
interpretation_svm: Domain Shift Undefined (NaN — single shared label)

adjudication.method: majority_confidence — where models agree on EmoT gold = HIGH confidence

limitation: EmoT is general domain (not MBG-specific). κ reflects cross-domain agreement — lower than same-domain IAA is expected.
references: Plank et al. (2014). Linguistically debatable or clearly wrong? NLP annotation.
Artstein & Poesio (2008). Inter-coder agreement for computational linguistics.
Koto et al. (2020). IndoNLU Benchmark. AACL 2020.
